messages.subject: rmr2 error
parts:
Hi All,

 I am facing with some an issue while calling a hdfs file to R and processing on it. Please help me on the same

 Before i go into the details I will show you the versions of my applications and then the steps I followed.

 OS Version:

hduser@VB:~$ lsb_release -a

No LSB modules are available.

Distributor ID:            Ubuntu

Description:     Ubuntu 13.04

Release:           13.04

Codename:      raring

 

Hadoop version:

hduser@VB:~$ hadoop version

Warning: $HADOOP_HOME is deprecated.

 

Hadoop 1.0.4

Subversion https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/hadoop/common/branches/branch-1.0 -r 1393290

Compiled by hortonfo on Wed Oct  3 05:13:58 UTC 2012

From source with checksum fe2baea87c4c81a2c505767f3f9b71f4

 

R version:

hduser@VB:~$ R --version

R version 3.0.1 (2013-05-16) -- "Good Sport"

Copyright (C) 2013 The R Foundation for Statistical Computing

Platform: x86_64-pc-linux-gnu (64-bit)

 

R is free software and comes with ABSOLUTELY NO WARRANTY.

You are welcome to redistribute it under the terms of the

GNU General Public License versions 2 or 3.

For more information about these matters see

http://www.gnu.org/licenses/.

 

rmr2 version:

rmr2_2.2.1

 

rhdfs version:

rhdfs_1.0.6

 

Simple test with rmr2 and hdfs: this is working with fine, no errors

> Sys.setenv(HADOOP_HOME="/usr/local/hadoop")

> Sys.setenv(HADOOP_CMD="/usr/local/hadoop/bin/hadoop")

> Sys.setenv(HADOOP_CONF="/usr/local/hadoop/conf")

> Sys.setenv(HADOOP_STREAMING="/usr/local/hadoop/contrib/streaming/hadoop-streaming-1.0.4.jar")

> library(rmr2)

> library(rhdfs)

> hdfs.init()

Warning: $HADOOP_HOME is deprecated.

 

> x=1:5

> hdfsx=to.dfs(x)

Warning: $HADOOP_HOME is deprecated.

 

13/07/17 13:52:46 INFO util.NativeCodeLoader: Loaded the native-hadoop library

13/07/17 13:52:46 INFO zlib.ZlibFactory: Successfully loaded & initialized native-zlib library

13/07/17 13:52:46 INFO compress.CodecPool: Got brand-new compressor

Warning message:

In to.dfs(x) : Converting to.dfs argument to keyval with a NULL key

> hdfs.ls("/tmp")

  permission  owner      group size          modtime             file

1 drwxr-xr-x hduser supergroup    0 2013-07-17 11:39  /tmp/RtmpJAA4m5

2 drwxr-xr-x hduser supergroup    0 2013-07-17 13:52  /tmp/RtmpXLa6qD

3 drwxr-xr-x hduser supergroup    0 2013-07-17 11:32 /tmp/hive-hduser

5 -rw-r--r-- hduser supergroup  165 2013-07-17 12:50  /tmp/wctest.txt

 

Reading hdfs file and processing word count example: this shwoing an error, not quit show what it is. I copied this example from the internet

 

> Sys.setenv(HADOOP_HOME="/usr/local/hadoop")

> Sys.setenv(HADOOP_CMD="/usr/local/hadoop/bin/hadoop")

> Sys.setenv(HADOOP_CONF="/usr/local/hadoop/conf")

> Sys.setenv(HADOOP_STREAMING="/usr/local/hadoop/contrib/streaming/hadoop-streaming-1.0.4.jar")

> library(rmr2)

> library(rhdfs)

> hdfs.init()

Warning: $HADOOP_HOME is deprecated.

 

> 

> wordcount=function(input,output=NULL,pattren="")

+ {

+   return(mapreduce(input=input,output=output,input.format="text",

+                    map=function(k,v) {lapply(strsplit(x=v,split=pattern)[[1]],function(w) keyval(w,1))},

+                    reduce=function(k,vv) {keyval(k,sum(unlist(vv)))},

+                    combine=T))

+ }

> 

> wordcount(input='/hdfs/hdfp/wctest.txt')

 I was going through the internet and I found example which got the same error “hadoop streaming failed with error code 1” link:

 As mention in the discussion, I tested the streaming jar file and below is the result and showing as still running

 hduser@VB:/tmp$ hadoop jar /usr/local/hadoop/contrib/streaming/hadoop-streaming-1.0.4.jar loadtb /tmp/test

Warning: $HADOOP_HOME is deprecated.

I am newbie to Ubuntu, hadoop and rmr, rhdfs. What was the problem where it has come?

You need to read the debugging guide and get me something I can work on. Just googling what you get in console in distributed mode won't get you anywhere.


Antonio
